reviews.text:
They welcomed Margot right on time, bathing her, perfumed her, and combed her very well.
A Pomeranian from Turin... just passing through before the return trip.
Thank you.
Mrs. Stefania was very kind and helpful. I went for the first time 3 weeks ago and was satisfied with the service. I can't rate the cut with scissors because we shaved to 1 cm. But I'm satisfied ☺️

If I could, I'd give it 0 stars. It's a terrible experience. I called and asked for a wash and a haircut, specifying my dog's size and weight. They told me it would cost 30-35 euros. I sent my daughter there, and when I paid, they said it would cost 50 euros because the scissors are more elaborate. The end result? Cuts on her belly and a terrible haircut! YOU ARE TERRIBLE!
Impossible to make an appointment either by landline or by whatsapp, I had to change my toilet
Terrible experience, extortion (€120 for a wash and, according to them, knot removal; the dog gets washed every month) and terror tactics to make you feel like a bad person. Stay away.
Friendly and sweet staff with my little furry Pomeranian ☺️
The only flaw is that they never answer the phone.
If you want to be BUZZED by your friends you are in the right place.....NEVER AGAIN!!!!!
For heaven's sake... ABSOLUTELY AVOID... they disfigured my Maltese... ARRONZONI!!!!!
Recommended by a friend, I found it good, very well stocked
I'm happy with the service, so I ask for either Marina or Stefania. I'll bring my dog's shampoo, as she's allergic.
People. Serious, clean shop, and Mrs. Stefania is a great groomer. Everything is beautiful and perfect. Great place. Magical. Super oasis.

Professional and precise.
Perhaps due to the change in staff, there are some inaccuracies in some areas (moustache trimming/eye hair), but that's fair enough as the guys are learning.

Recommended!
